---
title: "Workflows and outputs"
format: html
---

Maintained scripts under `examples/workflows/` cover ST summary and individual
models, annotations, MT mixtures, `selection_s`, convergence, selected markers,
and operator comparison.

Formatted fits share `family`, `model`, `operator`, `input`, `data`,
`model_parameters`, `diagnostics`, `convergence`, `convergence_traces`,
`chains`, and `memory_estimate`. Scientific model fields appear only where
defined; common structural fields remain present and may be `NULL`.

Use compact chains for task-level summaries and `convergence_control$keep_traces`
for formal diagnostic arrays. These controls are independent. Production
analyses require appropriate chain lengths, convergence review, and sensitivity
analysis beyond the small demonstration settings.
